title: Re-stage the SAME task id with a corrective constraint (edit the diagnosing-agent prompt)
acceptance_criteria: The _escalate_to_autobrief diagnosing-agent prompt (harness/autowork_daemon.py ~:700, the `prompt = f"..."` near :827) instructs the agent to produce a CORRECTED specification for the ORIGINAL task_id, preserving the same task_id and its dependency edges (so dependents like method_d_06_cross_examiner_wiring resolve on the same id) -- it must contain a marker such as 'original task_id' / 'corrected spec' / 'keep the original' / 'same task_id'.

The prompt embeds a corrective constraint addressing the diagnosed failure: for a banned-construct AST rejection it must forbid eval/exec/decorators (the prompt text must contain both the substrings 'eval' and 'exec' in a forbidding context).
The harvest+promote path (S2+S3) re-stages the ORIGINAL task_id via the deterministic selfheal_<task_id> slug rather than a parallel <id>_fix task, so dependents unblock on acceptance.

Re-staged self-heal tasks run the FULL pipeline (synthesis -> AST validation -> gates -> verification_command) and remain subject to the operator decision-JSON gate; the runaway ceiling (autowork.max_total_selfheal_escalations) and deterministic=>1-retry budget continue to bound cascades.
harness/autowork_daemon.py remains importable; the self-heal escalation still must NOT write the auto_promote.allowlist (test_allowlist_promotion_guard.py stays green).

spec.objective: Make the closed loop re-run the ORIGINAL rejected task with a better spec: the diagnosing agent emits a corrected specification keyed to the same task_id, with a corrective constraint derived from the diagnosed AST failure, so the full pipeline retries that id and its dependents unblock on acceptance.
functional_requirements: Update the _escalate_to_autobrief diagnosing-agent prompt to instruct producing a corrected specification for the ORIGINAL task_id, explicitly preserving the task id and its dependency edges (no parallel <id>_fix id).

Embed in the prompt a corrective constraint derived from the diagnosed cause (surfaced via the ast_validation_failed lifecycle reason from S1 through _get_errors_for_task): for a banned-construct AST rejection, 'edit the target directly; do NOT use eval/exec/decorators'.

Keep the brief filename pattern brief_hooks_<task_id>_fix.md so the S2 harvest (slug selfheal_<task_id>) maps deterministically back to the original task_id; re-staging flows through the existing _auto_promote -> compute_brief_status -> planner -> stage_task path.

Preserve all guardrails: the re-staged task runs the FULL pipeline, remains subject to the operator decision-JSON gate, and stays bounded by autowork.max_total_selfheal_escalations and the deterministic=>1-retry budget.
spec.interfaces: Edits ONLY the prompt string (the f-string assigned to `prompt` around autowork_daemon.py:827) inside _escalate_to_autobrief. The harvest+promote/re-stage mechanics are already provided by S2/S3; no new staging code here.
edge_cases: Original task has dependents -> dependency edges preserved (same task_id) so dependents unblock only on acceptance.
Diagnosed cause is not a banned-construct case -> the prompt still asks for a corrective constraint generically from the failure reason; the eval/exec wording is the banned-construct exemplar.
Escalation ceiling reached -> _escalate_to_autobrief returns before prompting (existing bound wins).
Flag false (S3) -> brief is written to the outbox but never harvested/re-staged (byte-identical to today).
non_goals: Do NOT create a parallel <id>_fix task id.
Do NOT weaken the AST AND-gate or relax validation.
Do NOT bypass the decision-JSON gate or the runaway ceiling.
Do NOT write or read the auto_promote.allowlist.
Do NOT set a working_dir front-matter key.
spec.implementation_notes:
Single EXISTING-function partial-edit: rewrite the `prompt` f-string inside _escalate_to_autobrief (harness/autowork_daemon.py, near :827). The current prompt only asks for a free-form 'self-healing plan'; it must (a) direct a CORRECTED specification for the ORIGINAL {task_id} (keep the same id so dependents resolve) and (b) forbid eval/exec/decorators in the corrective constraint. Keep the existing OUTBOX-only / no-git / no-allowlist guardrail sentences intact. The motivating case is method_d_05_taxonomy_flip rejected for Gemini's banned eval(); pull the concrete cause from the ast_validation_failed lifecycle row (S1) via _get_errors_for_task (already called as errors_str above the prompt). Inline string edit in an existing function -> pipeline-viable as partial_edit.

[ORACLE CONTRACT - test_selfheal_restage_same_id.py] ast.get_source_segment of _escalate_to_autobrief lowercased MUST contain both 'eval' AND 'exec', AND at least one of: 'same task_id','same task id','original task_id','original task id','corrected spec','keep the original','preserve the task_id'.
